<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-macro-skills.mjs from settings/macros.yaml — do not edit.
     Edit the `handoff` row there and run `npm run macro-skills`. -->

Write a handoff so a new session, which sees nothing of this conversation, can continue
the work. Save it in this session's scratchpad or the OS temp directory — never inside the
repository — and tell me the path.

Include, in this order:

1. GOAL — what the work is for, in two sentences.
2. STATE AT HEAD — for each branch and PR touched: its name, head SHA, CI state and
   mergeability, each marked OBSERVED (with when and how) or NOT OBSERVED. A PR title, a
   plan status or a ledger line is a record of intent, not state.
3. DECISIONS — each ruling made in this session, with its reason. These are settled; the
   next session must not re-open them without new evidence.
4. PENDING — every open item as a ledger: what it is, what blocks it, and who must act.
   Name any task id minted without a reservation as a FLOOR, not a claim.
5. TRAPS — what was tried and failed, and why, so it is not tried again.
6. NEXT PROMPT — the first prompt for the new session, complete and paste-ready. Its header
   names the repo, the account, the branch cut from latest `main`, and the mode: RECON or
   IMPLEMENT.

Point to what already exists — PRs, commits, plan shards, files — by id AND title; do not
restate it. Redact every secret, token and personal detail.

Rules this invokes (CLAUDE.md):

- Ledger and evidence discipline
- Plan and task hygiene

$ARGUMENTS
